A1.justification: Both readable, complete 17-page PDFs describe EgoMind and contain corresponding main sections, equations, figures, tables, and supplementary Sections A–D. The material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original EgoMind benchmark evaluations, component ablations, model-scale experiments, reasoning-trace audits, and zero-shot prompting results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Tables 1–4, Table E, and supplementary Sections B–D.

M1.justification: RPC, PSA, CoT generation, and SFT/GRPO procedures remain unchanged. Figure 3's corrected attribution of viewpoint-transition inference to GPT-4o matches the procedure already described in v1 Section 3.4.

E1.justification: Both versions use SpaceR-91k training data and evaluate the same VSI-Bench, SPAR-Bench, SITE-Bench video subset, and SPBench tasks. No dataset, domain, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the benchmark and ablation comparisons. Table 1 corrects the spellings of InternVL3.5 and MiniCPM-V 4.5; their citations and corresponding results identify the same existing baselines.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model scales, frame sampling, resolution limits, metrics, and evaluation procedures are retained. Appendix D explicitly describes replacing generic CoT with EgoMind prompting, clarifying the setup already documented through Appendix A.2 and Figure G in v1.

E4.justification: The RPC/PSA ablations, alternative component designs, frame-count analysis, model-scale study, intermediate-trace audit, metric-hint experiment, and qualitative failure cases are all retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Appendix B.2 retains the same binary judge scoring and percentage aggregation procedure.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical results and qualitative findings match. Examples include EgoMind's 50.16 on VSI-Bench in Table 1, the 3B model's 45.44 in Table E, and Gemini's 50.62-to-59.73 prompting comparison in Appendix D.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 adds an explicit self-inclusion condition to the spatial-neighborhood definition. The displayed Equation (4) remains unchanged, making this a limited textual qualification. Equation (5)'s explicit object/relation pair and Equation (8)'s variable substitutions otherwise clarify existing mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about geometry-free linguistic spatial reasoning, automated data generation, data efficiency, and competitive benchmark performance.

C2.justification: The mechanism explanations, interpretation of experimental results, and applicability boundaries are retained. The limitations paragraph is reworded but preserves temporal-reasoning, synthetic-data-diversity, and larger-model-validation limitations; the appendix retains the same failure explanations.

D1.justification: Figure 3 corrects the documented division of labor: GPT-4o infers viewpoint transitions and Qwen2.5-72B synthesizes RPC, consistent with the existing method text. Appendix D explicitly identifies the generic-to-EgoMind prompt replacement. Hyperparameters and code/data access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction removes Spatial-MLLM [44] from its examples of purely image–language approaches, aligning that passage with its retained treatment as using 3D priors. The bibliography and broader research positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized wording and terminology corrections, including the limitations paragraph, zero-shot discussion, model names, and failure-case references. The section order and overall narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3's caption is revised, Table 1 and Figure D receive label corrections, and Table E's caption standardizes the benchmark name. Local equation spacing and text reflow change, while all figures and tables are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves accuracy and internal consistency: Figure 3 resolves a conflicting account of which model infers viewpoint transitions, the introduction corrects Spatial-MLLM's positioning, and Appendix D makes the existing prompting comparison explicit. These changes make the work easier to interpret and reproduce, while its experimental evidence and central conclusions remain unchanged.
